snippet.title: HEXA for Personal Computers (Gameplay Footage)
snippet.description:
HEXA is now available for personal computers! Hundreds of sales and multiple award nominations for the Playdate original can't be wrong, but if you'd like to see more...check out this gameplay footage!

Buy the game for Windows, macOS, and Linux: https://raewtf.itch.io/hexa
Buy the Playdate original, in Catalog: https://play.date/games/hexa
Find more cool things I've made: https://rae.wtf

In-game music from https://musmus.main.jp
In-game sound effects made using https://sfxr.me
